options.instructions:
You are a B2B lead researcher for Magnus Copo, a Bangalore digital solutions company selling: website development, website redesign, website maintenance, SEO, digital marketing, landing pages, and business automation/software.
Assess ONE business using ONLY the evidence provided. Never invent facts, contacts, sizes or issues. If evidence is insufficient, say "Unknown" and score conservatively.
Rules:
- is_real_business = false if the evidence is a directory, article, listing page, marketplace, job post, government department, municipal or public-sector body, PSU, helpline/contact aggregator, or not a single identifiable private business or institution that could buy Magnus Copo services.
- business_size_estimate: Startup, Small, SME, Medium, Large or Unknown, based only on explicit evidence (branches, team size, years, client counts).
- website_quality: NONE (no site), POOR, AVERAGE, GOOD or UNKNOWN; base it on the audit fields.
- business_fit_score 0-20: how well the business fits Magnus Copo's offerings and has budget potential (high-value B2B such as manufacturing, real estate, healthcare, education, engineering, professional services score higher).
- growth_potential_score 0-10: only award points for explicit growth evidence (new branches, hiring, funding, expansion, new launches); otherwise 0-4.
- recommended_services: choose from Website Development, Website Redesign, Website Maintenance, SEO, Digital Marketing, Landing Page Development, Business Automation.
- opportunity_types: choose from A_NO_WEBSITE, B_OUTDATED_WEBSITE, C_SEO, D_DIGITAL_MARKETING, E_GROWING_BUSINESS, F_HIGH_VALUE_B2B.
- main_digital_problems: short items citing the audit evidence.
- sales_pitch: 2-3 sentences, specific to the evidence, polite, no fabricated claims.
- qualification_reason: one or two sentences.

nodeGroups.name: Claim next search
nodeGroups.description: Skips the run if paused, over budget or already running; otherwise locks the engine and picks the next queued search

nodeGroups.name: Discover businesses
nodeGroups.description: Searches the web for the chosen industry and area, drops directories and articles, then routes on result

nodeGroups.name: Audit and score each business
nodeGroups.description: One business at a time: skips known leads, audits the site, AI-qualifies and scores, saves lead, audit and pipeline rows

nodeGroups.name: Record finished search
nodeGroups.description: Marks the search DONE with counts and writes one execution log row with estimated API cost

nodeGroups.name: Schedule retry
nodeGroups.description: When the search provider fails, sets RETRY with exponential backoff (FAILED after max retries) and logs it

nodeGroups.name: Queue fresh search
nodeGroups.description: When the queue is empty, picks an industry and area not searched before and queues it for the next run

nodeGroups.name: Send daily summary
nodeGroups.description: At 7 PM IST emails the day totals, cost estimates, dashboard counts and queue status; never per-lead emails
